728-801-2464-3249.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-801-2464-3249.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-801-2464-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

132-549-4306-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-549-4306-4687.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue or to green is at least three.
132-549-4306-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-549-4306-4687.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if your devotion to blue or to green is at least four.

4247-6517-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

65-2546-2628-4823--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-4823--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

261-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

141-2292-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-4153-4659-6775.description:
Cast Dyadrine from the command zone by paying {G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable. Dyadrine will enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Dyadrine, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Dyadrine from the battlefield to the command zone.
When Dyadrine dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler equal to the number Dyadrine had as it died.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing all +1/+1 counters placed on it in step 4, adding {G}{W} and then {1} for each remaining counter.
Repeat.

Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.

It is an opponent's turn.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}.

During an opponent's turn, after their upkeep step, activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}.
